title: Routes of Drug Administration
description: Onset and duration of pentobarbitone sleep via oral, s.c., i.m., i.p. and i.v. routes in mice.

title: Effects of Drugs on Rabbit Eye
description: Mydriatics, miotics and local anaesthetics: pupil size, light reflex and corneal reflex.

title: Anticonvulsant Activity: MES (Electroconvulsometer)
description: Maximal electroshock seizures in rats; abolition of tonic hind-limb extension by phenytoin.

title: Muscle Relaxant Activity: Rota-Rod
description: Fall-off time of mice on a rotating rod before and after diazepam.

title: Anticonvulsant Activity: PTZ-Induced Seizures
description: Latency and protection against pentylenetetrazole clonic convulsions with diazepam.

title: Hepatic Enzyme Induction: Phenobarbitone Sleeping Time
description: Effect of enzyme inducers and inhibitors on barbiturate sleeping time in mice.

title: Ciliary Motility of Frog Oesophagus
description: Time for a poppy seed to travel 20 mm along the oesophagus with ACh, physostigmine and atropine.

title: Local Anaesthetics
description: Surface (rabbit cornea), infiltration and nerve-block methods; onset and duration.

title: Locomotor Activity: Actophotometer
description: CNS depressant and stimulant effects on photocell beam counts in mice.

title: Catalepsy & Stereotypy
description: Haloperidol-induced catalepsy (bar test) and amphetamine stereotypy; reversal by anti-catatonic drugs.

title: Anxiolytic Activity: Elevated Plus Maze
description: Open-arm entries and time spent with diazepam in mice.

title: DRC of Acetylcholine: Frog Rectus Abdominis
description: Graded contractions on a kymograph; log dose–response curve and EC50.

title: Physostigmine & Atropine on ACh DRC (Rat Ileum)
description: Left shift by anticholinesterase and parallel right shift by competitive antagonist.

title: Histamine Bioassay: Matching Method
description: Estimate an unknown histamine concentration on guinea-pig ileum by matching responses.

title: Histamine Bioassay: Interpolation & Bracketing
description: Interpolate the test response between standard doses.

title: Three-Point Bioassay
description: Two standard doses and one test dose; potency by formula.

title: Four-Point Bioassay
description: Two standard and two test doses in Latin-square order; potency ratio.

title: pA2 Value: Schild Plot
description: pA2 of atropine (ACh) or mepyramine (histamine) from dose ratios.

title: Analgesic Activity: Eddy's Hot Plate
description: Reaction time (paw licking / jumping) with morphine or pentazocine.

title: Analgesic Activity: Tail-Flick Analgesiometer
description: Radiant heat tail withdrawal latency and % maximum possible effect.

title: Anti-inflammatory Activity: Carrageenan Paw Oedema
description: Plethysmometer paw volume and % inhibition with indomethacin / diclofenac.

title: Drugs on Blood Pressure & Heart Rate
description: Dale's adrenaline reversal, ACh reversal after atropine, histamine and β-agonist responses in the anaesthetised rat.

title: Anti-ulcer Activity: Pylorus Ligation
description: Gastric volume, acidity and ulcer index with ranitidine / omeprazole.

title: Gastrointestinal Motility: Charcoal Meal
description: Percentage intestinal transit with atropine and metoclopramide; measure the charcoal front on a scale.

title: Antidiarrhoeal Activity: Castor Oil Model
description: Onset, wet and total faeces with loperamide and atropine; % inhibition.
